population_scope: SAVH blind randomized OCR holdout outside the development partition; conditional on approved human reference labels
exclusion_reason: C015 has no row in the approved human-reference file; exclusion is retained and must be resolved or replaced through a predeclared random draw before claiming full eligibility coverage.

known_limitations: one of 58 sampled records was not scoreable against approved ground truth
the published holdout is not stratified across the full range of cameras, lighting, distance, plate size, and operating conditions
results do not estimate performance over all vehicle passes or all future deployments

video_evaluation.wilson_interval: not reported: incomplete ground truth and clustered repeated reads violate the independent, fully labelled trial assumptions

notes: Intervals are nominal 95% Wilson score intervals and assume independent Bernoulli units and a valid random sample from the stated target population. They do not correct nonresponse, label error, cluster dependence, or population coverage.
